source: Counted 2026-11-01 (lane #172) from the landmark-brief.ts crops of the Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0).

facades.name: Singel front
facades.note: Nine bays between the piers in every storey (basement grilles in the plinth partly hidden by bicycles and a van: not counted). The banded south corner zone with its narrow single window per storey (about half a bay wide on Commons Bungehuis.jpg, modelled 1.1 m) is outside alongM: the rhythm audit reads a deliberately narrower corner window as off-size. Level cornice with a pinnacle on every pier; the stepped-down corner and its pinnacle read as two peaks to the counter, so no gable count is declared here (the Spuistraat faces keep gables 0). depthBand 2 (the Paleisstraat corner pier's pinnacle stands 2.6 m behind this plane).

facades.name: Spuistraat north of the entrance
facades.note: Three bays in every storey; the banded corner zone at the right has no window on this face. Basement grilles not counted.

facades.name: Spuistraat south of the entrance
facades.note: Six bays between the jog at the south wing and the entrance block (the sixth half-hidden by the entrance block at the right edge); basement grilles not counted.
